name: Chatbase MCP
description: Connects MCP clients to a Chatbase workspace over OAuth to manage AI support agents, their training sources, conversations, and help desk tickets.

skills.name: Agent Management
skills.description: Lists, creates, clones, updates, and deletes Chatbase AI agents, toggles auto-retrain, and sends a chat message to an agent.

skills.name: Source Management
skills.description: Adds, edits, and removes the knowledge sources an AI agent is trained on, with each change taking effect without a separate training step.

skills.name: Conversation Export
skills.description: Exports an agent's conversations for analysis and updates conversation metadata through chatbase_export_conversations and related tools.

skills.name: Help Desk Tickets
skills.description: Searches, reads, creates, and updates help desk tickets, posts ticket replies, and lists ticket statuses and help desk teams.
